items.t: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS) Locks In Offshore Launch Access Starting In 2027
items.sum: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (NasdaqGS:KTOS) has signed a long term agreement with Seagate Space for offshore launches. The deal gives Kratos access to Seagate Space's Gateway platform, an offshore launch site aimed at space operations.
